why: Weight is the half of the opposition that survives motion. Direction reads in a still frame; a heavy band versus a thin line is what still reads when both events last under a second and the player is looking somewhere else. Dropping it leaves the arm relying entirely on a direction change the issue's own complaint says is easy to miss.
